prefix: Execute the same three unit-cost catalog probes in every world. No lemma is acquired. Full history identifies the world. Prefix cost and acquired set reveal no additional world information.
handoff: Deterministic root-specific encoder with at most K labels. Decoder knows the codebook and receives only the label, public problem, acquired set and remaining budget. Its posterior is the code cell with the original prior weights restricted to that cell. Subsequent belief memory and planning are unrestricted.
primary_contrast: Relative reward loss of the optimal two-label handoff versus full-history continuation, averaged equally over the 48 development roots
headroom_gate: mean relative loss >= 1/20 AND at least 1/5 of roots have relative loss >= 1/10; result only informs future design
controls: Optimal one through eight-label codebooks; fixed last-one and last-two observation windows. All six probe orders reported for windows. Primary order fixed at 012; no best-order selection.
identity_control: Every full probe order reconstructs the same singleton posterior and full-history value. This is an exact identity, not calibrated empirical sham evidence.
pair_witnesses: Report every unordered pair of worlds. Common first action ranges over all physically legal actions, including deterministic no-progress actions and stopping; true world is restored after that action. Report its optimistic lower bound on aliasing loss. A window witness must share the retained suffix.
audits: Independent explicit-world Bellman values for all 255 nonempty posterior supports per root; independent enumeration of all 4140 partitions; exact replay of six policy families in all eight worlds; prefix, handoff, nonanticipation, safe budget and first-action witness checks
unit_accounting: 48 roots within four reused generator lineages; eight worlds and six probe orders are repeated observations. No certified independent population or sealed confirmation.
selection_exposure: Protocol frozen before pilot execution. Pilot and main sweep are public development; all codebooks are optimized with the full known root model.
cost_contract: Declared positive verification-cost units, including the prefix. Planning and codebook construction receive no wall-time cap; codebook storage is free shared side information.
scope: One handoff information bottleneck, not an end-to-end finite-state controller. No neural fits, paid compute, training allocation or manuscript ingestion. No claim about ordering textual mathematical discovery.
